== Description ==

A player's hand of green-sleeved cards led by ''Baragwin'' during the Friday Cube Draft side event at the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2025-world-championship-seattle, Teacher, 3 October 2025 (12:20 PDT): "Cube draft in process: / “I have all the best cards” ~ Benji". Original file name: IMG_8034.jpg (4032×3024); Slack file id F09JS8PL4J0.
* '''Shared by:''' Teacher (Slack)
* '''Date:''' 3 October 2025 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' Only an arm and hand are visible; the quote in the caption attributes the hand to [[Benji Chu]].
